title: Crestline Credit Card Uplift on Out-of-Area Repair Reimbursements
content:
Crestline Credit Card holders receive an uplift on the reimbursement of an out-of-area tire repair under Road Hazard Protection.

**Repair card uplift.** A holder who has a Crestline Credit Card account in status active and no late fee posted on their Crestline card accounts in the last 12 whole calendar months adds 10 USD to the out-of-area repair reimbursement; a holder with an active Crestline card account and one or more such late fees in that period adds 5 USD; any other holder adds nothing.

The uplift is added to the out-of-area repair reimbursement.

| Active Crestline Credit Card account | Late fees, last 12 whole months | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 10.00 |
| yes | one or more | 5.00 |
| no | (not relevant) | none |
